source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보 데이터에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

baseline_prompt_en: A complex fashion photograph shows a fictional adult woman, approximately 28, in a heated high-altitude observatory at moonlit early evening. Her visible facial appearance follows the attached portrait: a small oval contour with a tapered lower jaw, a dark clearly shaped uncovered eye, a straight delicate nose with a rounded tip, and softly full rose-pink lips. Her hair is a charcoal-black bob with a dense diagonal fringe descending continuously from the scalp across her left eye to the cheek; the left eye is fully concealed while her right eye remains readable. One short, separate curved tuft springs upward from the crown against a clear pale background. She wears a charcoal structured jumpsuit with open black diamond-mesh upper sleeves: individual intersecting strands surround repeated hollow openings, and actual skin is visible through those openings. Copper forearm gauntlets cross both wrists and extend over the backs of her hands to the knuckle roots, with her fingers individually exposed. She is watching a fresh ink trace on the chart recorder beside the telescope mount. Her right elbow bends loosely, and her right index fingertip rests beside the new ink trace. Her left hand lies palm down on the waist-high rail, showing the copper guard across the back of the hand. Her torso stays upright with a relaxed, balanced stance. Behind her, the telescope barrel recedes diagonally into the open dome; a service doorway reveals blue snow ridges beneath a small early-evening moon. Fine meltwater drops shine on a rubber floor mat at the doorway. A warm task lamp gives the visible eye, lips, mesh openings and copper edges tactile clarity against the cool mountain light. A vertical mid-thigh environmental portrait at a natural eye-level viewpoint includes clear space above the raised crown strand and both complete hands, with the instrument, subject and distant ridges legible as separate depth layers. Natural skin texture and precise fabric edges hold the photograph's quiet presence.
